The KO table is the hand-off to 06 and 07. 4. **Rarefied sensitivity**: the habitat classes recomputed at equal sequencing depth. _Definitions_: **Unit expression.** Below, a unit expression is the scaledTPM that remains after Eukaryota only and Opisthokonta assignments are removed, averaged over replicates. Every proportion below is taken against that total. **Detection/prevalence.** A feature is detected in a sample unit when its unit total is ≥ `detect_min_tpm` (1) scaledTPM **and** ≥ `detect_min_per_million` (10) per million of that unit's expression. ScaledTPM carries library size, and unit expression differs about 170-fold among units. A set TPM floor lets deep units detect more. The per-million floor preserves the samples that were sequenced deeply, the TPM floor preserves shallow ones. **Occupancy/Distribution.** Associated with a habitat = detected in >= 30% of its units (`occupancy_min_frac`: >= 4 of 13 vent units, >= 2 of 6 non-vent units). A fraction rather than a count, so the bar is the same height in both habitats. **Vent-only** is strict: vent-associated and detected in no non-vent unit. **Counts are relative.** A smaller sum of scaltedTPM at vents means a smaller slice of protist expression, not fewer cells. # Set up ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "scripts/_setup.R") ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} FIELDS_IN_SCOPE <- c("Gorda Ridge", "Von Damm", "Piccard") CHOSEN_DEPTH <- 4 # tax level setting # Set in params in config/ MIN_TPM <- params$detect_min_tpm; MIN_TPM # 1 ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 1 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} MIN_PER_MILLION <- params$detect_min_per_million; MIN_PER_MILLION #10 ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 10 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} OCC_MIN <- params$occupancy_min_frac; OCC_MIN # 0.30 ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] 0.3 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # thresholds for taxa across habitats N_LEADERS <- 10 # top ten taxa per habitat shown N_RAREFY <- 20 # rarefaction draws # the 95th-percentile permutation threshold (perm95_threshold) marks it as significant. DELTA_ENRICH <- 0.5 # |Cliff's delta| >= this = enriched / overrepresented ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # built once at the end of 02 (R/load_paired.R) paired <- load_paired(fields = FIELDS_IN_SCOPE, depth = CHOSEN_DEPTH) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` [load_paired] data/processed/paired_L4.RData (built 2026-10-23 09:06; 318,911 rows) ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} units <- paired |> distinct(unit = sample_unit, vent_bin, field, n_reps) |> arrange(vent_bin, field, unit) # stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(units$unit)) units |> count(vent_bin, field) #Check numebr ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}

Taxa are ordered within their curated group. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} leader_pts <- complete_units(tax_unit |> filter(cur_L4 %in% leaders), units, c("cur_group", "cur_L4")) |> mutate(taxon = taxon_label_unique(cur_L4), cur_group = factor(cur_group, levels = SUPERGROUP_0_ordering)) |> arrange(cur_group, taxon) |> mutate(taxon = fct_rev(fct_inorder(taxon))) fig_leaders <- leader_pts |> ggplot(aes(x = taxon, y = share)) + stat_summary(aes(group = vent_bin), fun = median, fun.min = median, fun.max = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.6, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey30", position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) + geom_point(aes(fill = cur_group, shape = vent_bin, group = vent_bin), size = 1.9, alpha = 0.85, position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, jitter.height = 0, dodge.width = 0.7, seed = 1)) + scale_fill_manual(values = tax_color_metaT, name = NULL) + scale_shape_manual(values = c(Vent = 24, `Non-vent` = 21), name = NULL) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) + coord_flip() + labs(y = "Proportion of unit expression (scaledTPM)", x = "") + theme_classic(base_size = 10) fig_leaders # ggsave("figures/05-leaders.svg", fig_leaders, width = 8, height = 6) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](05-vent-nonvent-signatures_files/figure-html/fig-leaders-1.png){#fig-leaders width=768} ::: ::: > Top ten taxa by mean proportion in each habitat. Each point is one sample unit and bars mark the habitat median. Units where a taxon is absent are plotted at zero. Taxa are ordered within, and colored by, curated group ## Composition contrast: vent versus non-vent Shares sum to 1 within a unit, so a larger share for one taxon forces smaller shares elsewhere. The contrast is therefore tested on robust-CLR values (zeros kept at 0, the 02/04 choice), and shares are used only for display. Three outputs: * **Whole composition:** PERMANOVA on rclr Euclidean (Aitchison) distance, vent versus non-vent, with a PERMDISP check; 13 vs. 6 units is unbalanced, so a dispersion difference can masquerade as a location difference. * **Per taxon:** Cliff's delta (vent focal) on rclr, with a 95th-percentile permutation threshold across all features in the family, the same primary filter as 05. * **Display:** each unit's share, zero where absent, with the habitat median. Units, not libraries, are the replicates throughout. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} N_PERM_COMP <- 2000 composition_rclr <- function(ue, by_col) { ue |> select(unit, feature = all_of(by_col), tpm) |> pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = tpm, values_fill = 0) |> column_to_rownames("unit") |> as.matrix() |> rclr_transform() } compare_composition <- function(z, n_perm = N_PERM_COMP) { hab <- set_names(units$vent_bin, units$unit)[rownames(z)] observed <- contrast_ranks(z, hab, "Vent") null_max <- map_dbl(seq_len(n_perm), \(i) max(abs(contrast_ranks(z, set_names(sample(hab), names(hab)), "Vent")), na.rm = TRUE)) tibble(feature = names(observed), cliffs_delta = observed, perm95_threshold = unname(quantile(null_max, 0.95))) |> # enriched: effect-size line; significant: beyond the 95th percentile of the permuted largest |delta| mutate(enriched = abs(cliffs_delta) >= DELTA_ENRICH, significant = abs(cliffs_delta) >= perm95_threshold) } set.seed(params$seed) z_group <- composition_rclr(group_unit, "cur_group") z_taxon <- composition_rclr(tax_unit, "cur_L4") # whole composition: PERMANOVA + PERMDISP on rclr Euclidean distance composition_permanova <- imap_dfr(list(curated_group = z_group, class_level = z_taxon), \(z, grain) { meta <- tibble(unit = rownames(z)) |> left_join(units, by = "unit") d <- vegan::vegdist(z, method = "euclidean") perm <- vegan::adonis2(d ~ vent_bin, data = meta, permutations = 9999) disp <- vegan::permutest(vegan::betadisper(d, meta$vent_bin), permutations = 9999) tibble(grain, n_features = ncol(z), R2 = perm$R2[1], p = perm$`Pr(>F)`[1], dispersion_p = disp$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]) }) composition_permanova ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
